findings.evidence: http://HOST/ (HTTP 200) serves 496 characters of content but contains 0 <nav> landmarks, 0 internal links and 0 external links; header/footer/breadcrumb landmarks present: 0 of 3. The same pattern holds on 1 of 1 measurable pages, so every page is a dead end for a visitor who arrives from a search result or an AI citation.

suggested_action.mechanism: Internal links are how crawlers discover pages and how AI systems infer site structure and topical relationships; without them each page is an isolated document, and a visitor who lands mid-site has no path to a conversion step.
suggested_action.summary: Add a persistent header <nav> linking Home, About, Products, Pricing and Contact on every HTML page, a footer with the same site-wide links plus policy pages, and breadcrumbs marked up as machine-readable BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on sub-pages. Cross-link related products and articles in body copy so visitors and AI crawlers can discover, extract and cite the rest of the site from any entry point.

findings.title: The site offers no navigation or internal linking for orientation

findings.evidence: 0 of 1 crawled pages expose structured data: http://HOST/ (HTTP 200) serves 496 characters (60 words) of organisation, product and contact information in prose but contains 0 application/ld+json blocks and 0 itemtype/typeof attributes.

suggested_action.mechanism: Schema.org markup is the one channel where a site states its own facts unambiguously; without it every extraction is an inference that an assistant may decline to cite.
suggested_action.summary: Add an Organization JSON-LD block in the HTML <head> of every page (name, url, logo, description, address, contactPoint, sameAs) and Product/Offer JSON-LD next to each product section, so the facts that are currently prose-only become machine-readable and AI systems can extract and cite them as attributed entity data instead of inferring them from the copy.

findings.title: No machine-readable structured data (JSON-LD, microdata or RDFa) anywhere on the site

recommendations.title: Add the rest of the metadata layer alongside the schema
Add Product structured data for individual products after the Organization block
Add internal links between related content pages
Publish an XML sitemap with lastmod dates
Add an explicit robots.txt that names AI user agents
Add FAQPage structured data for the questions buyers ask
Use one spelling of the company name in every identity slot
Add breadcrumb navigation for user and bot orientation
